title: AWS Collector Output
description: Security posture output from the epack AWS collector. The `collected_at_level` field indicates how much detail this artifact contains. Level-gated arrays are absent below their level, `[]` when collected with no rows, and `[...]` when populated. A value the collector could not read is null, and the run's result says why. See docs/levels.md for the artifact contract.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the artifact follows. Always 1.0.0 in v1.

collected_at.description: When the collection ran, in RFC 3339.

collected_at_level.description: Collection level the artifact was produced at. See docs/levels.md.

accounts.description: One entry for each account the collector signed in to, in the order the configuration lists them.

failed_accounts.description: Configured accounts whose collection failed entirely, so no entry exists for them under accounts. Absent when every account answered.

account_id.description: Parsed from the configured role ARN; absent when not derivable (e.g. default credentials).

role_arn.description: The role the account's configuration entry names, when it names one.

label.description: Operator-supplied label from the account's config entry.

error_code.description: AWS's error code for the failure that stopped the account's collection, such as AccessDenied, or NonAPIError when AWS sent none.

diagnostics.description: Per-account errors and surface-level warnings encountered during collection. Absent when there were none.

account_errors.description: One message for each configured account whose collection failed entirely.

warnings.description: Messages about reads that failed, were cut short, or met an unexpected answer. The run's result lists each value left out and why.

AccountPosture.description: The security posture of one AWS account.

account_alias.description: The account's IAM alias. Absent when the account has none.

account_label.description: Operator-supplied label from the account's config entry (e.g. production, staging), passed through verbatim. Absent when not configured.

regions.description: The regions scanned: the configured list, or every region the account has enabled.

iam.description: IAM users, their credentials, the password policy, the root user, and roles.

s3.description: S3 buckets: public access blocks, encryption, versioning, logging, and transport enforcement.

rds.description: RDS databases across the scanned regions.

network.description: VPCs and security group exposure across the scanned regions.

account_security.description: The account's security services: CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, IAM Access Analyzer, Security Hub, and Inspector.

identity_center.description: IAM Identity Center in the primary region, the first region scanned.

lambda.description: Lambda functions across the scanned regions.

ec2.description: EC2 instances and EBS volumes across the scanned regions.

cloudwatch_logs.description: CloudWatch log groups across the scanned regions.

monitoring.description: CloudWatch alarms across the scanned regions, and whether their notifications reach anyone.

stored_images.description: EBS snapshots and AMIs the account owns, across the scanned regions.

load_balancers.description: Elastic Load Balancing load balancers and target groups across the scanned regions.

ses.description: SES configuration sets and sending identities across the scanned regions.

ecs.description: ECS services across the scanned regions.

auto_scaling.description: EC2 Auto Scaling groups across the scanned regions.

waf.description: WAF web ACLs across the scanned regions and the CloudFront scope.

kms.description: Customer managed KMS keys across the scanned regions.

secrets_manager.description: Secrets Manager secrets across the scanned regions.

ssm_parameters.description: Systems Manager Parameter Store parameters across the scanned regions.

IAMMetrics.description: IAM in the account. The user figures come from the IAM credential report, the root user excluded.

credential_report_evaluated.description: True when the IAM credential report was collected. The user aggregates (iam_users_present, mfa_enabled, hardware_mfa_enabled, access_keys_rotated) are meaningful only when true; on collection failure they are null.

credential_report_error_code.description: Present when the credential report was not evaluated (e.g. CredentialReportTimeout).

iam_users_present.description: Whether the credential report lists any IAM user besides the root user.

iam_user_count.description: IAM users in the credential report, the root user excluded.

access_key_user_count.description: IAM users with at least one active access key.

password_policy_evaluated.description: True when the account password policy was read, whether or not one is configured. False means the lookup failed; see password_policy_error_code.

password_policy_error_code.description: Why the account password policy could not be read.

password_policy.description: The configured account password policy for IAM console sign-in. Null while password_policy_evaluated is true means no policy is configured and AWS's own default applies, which is a finding rather than missing data.

minimum_length.description: Shortest console password the account accepts.

require_symbols.description: Whether passwords must contain a symbol.

require_numbers.description: Whether passwords must contain a number.

require_uppercase.description: Whether passwords must contain an uppercase letter.

require_lowercase.description: Whether passwords must contain a lowercase letter.

allow_users_to_change_password.description: Whether IAM users can change their own passwords.

hard_expiry.description: Whether users are locked out rather than prompted once a password expires.

max_password_age_days.description: Absent means passwords do not expire.

password_reuse_prevention.description: Absent means previous passwords may be reused.

password_policy.x-epack-null: No account password policy is configured, so AWS's default applies

mfa_enabled.description: Percentage of IAM users with an MFA device active. Null when there are no IAM users.

mfa_enabled_user_count.description: IAM users with an MFA device active.

hardware_mfa_enabled.description: Percentage of IAM users with a hardware MFA device, a FIDO security key or a hardware TOTP token rather than a virtual device. Null when there are no IAM users.

hardware_mfa_enabled_user_count.description: IAM users with a hardware MFA device: a FIDO security key or a hardware TOTP token rather than a virtual device.

access_keys_rotated.description: Percentage of IAM users with an active access key whose every active key was created or rotated in the last 90 days. Null when no user has an active key.

access_keys_rotated_user_count.description: IAM users with an active access key whose every active key was created or rotated in the last 90 days.

root_credential_state_evaluated.description: True when root credential state was read from the credential report or the account summary. The root_* credential flags are meaningful only when true.

root_mfa_enabled.description: True when root MFA is active.

root_credentials_present.description: Whether the root user has a password, an access key, or a signing certificate.

root_password_present.description: Whether the root user has a password. The credential report alone cannot tell, so it comes from the account summary.

root_access_keys_exist.description: Whether the root user has an access key.

root_signing_certificates_present.description: Whether the root user has an X.509 signing certificate.

root_access_protected.description: True when root MFA is active or no long-term root credentials are present.

root_organizations_features_evaluated.description: True when IAM's centralized root access features were read. root_organization_id and the two feature flags are meaningful only when true.

root_organization_id.description: The AWS Organizations ID that IAM's centralized root access features report.

root_credentials_management_feature_enab.description: True when IAM ListOrganizationsFeatures reported the RootCredentialsManagement centralized root access feature.

root_sessions_feature_enabled.description: True when IAM ListOrganizationsFeatures reported the RootSessions centralized root access feature.

root_organizations_features_error_code.description: Present when the centralized root access feature read was not evaluated.

organization_accounts_evaluated.description: True when the AWS Organizations account roster was listed. Per-role external_trust_in_org determinations are meaningful only when true; member accounts without Organizations visibility record the error code without a warning.

organization_accounts_error_code.description: Present when the organization account roster was not evaluated.

users.description: Audit level and above: one row per IAM user in the credential report, the root user excluded.

roles.description: Audit level and above: one row per IAM role, with what its trust policy allows from outside the account.

credential_report.description: Internal level only: the IAM credential report the user figures come from, with each user's sign-in and access key activity.

generated_at.description: When AWS generated the report, in RFC 3339.

users.description: One row per user in the report, the root user included.

bucket_listing_evaluated.description: True when the bucket listing was collected. The bucket aggregates below are meaningful only when true; on listing failure they are null.

bucket_listing_error_code.description: Present when the bucket listing was not evaluated.

account_public_access_block_evaluated.description: True when the account-level S3 Block Public Access settings were read. account_public_access_block_enabled is meaningful only when true.

bucket_count.description: Total S3 buckets returned by ListBuckets.

tls_enforced_bucket_count.description: Buckets whose policy conclusively denies plaintext access for every principal, every S3 action, and the whole bucket.

tls_enforcement_partial_bucket_count.description: Buckets with a transport deny that does not conclusively cover the whole bucket: scoped principals, subset actions, extra conditions, or partial resources.

tls_unenforced_bucket_count.description: Buckets whose policy says nothing about transport, or that have no policy. S3 endpoints answer HTTP, so plaintext requests are allowed.

tls_enforcement_unknown_bucket_count.description: Buckets whose policy could not be read. Unknown is never reported as unenforced.

public_access_blocked.description: Percentage of buckets whose effective S3 Block Public Access settings block public access.

public_access_blocked_bucket_count.description: Buckets whose effective S3 Block Public Access settings block public access: each of the four flags set by the account or by the bucket.

public_access_block_unknown_count.description: Buckets whose effective S3 Block Public Access setting could not be fully evaluated.

default_encryption_enabled.description: Percentage of buckets whose default encryption was evaluated and enabled.

default_encryption_enabled_bucket_count.description: Buckets whose default encryption was evaluated and enabled.

default_encryption_evaluated_count.description: Buckets whose default encryption was read, or inferred from S3's SSE-S3 baseline when the bucket has no rule of its own.

default_encryption_inferred_count.description: Evaluated buckets counted as encrypted from documented AWS SSE-S3 baseline behavior rather than a readable encryption rule.

default_encryption_unknown_count.description: Buckets whose default encryption could not be read.

versioning_enabled.description: Percentage of buckets with versioning enabled. Null when there are no buckets.

logging_enabled.description: Percentage of buckets with server access logging enabled. Log sink buckets (targets of other buckets' logging) are excluded from the denominator.

logging_enabled_bucket_count.description: Buckets that are not a server access log destination and have server access logging enabled.

log_sink_bucket_count.description: Buckets identified as server access log destinations for at least one other bucket. These are excluded from the logging_enabled denominator.

logging_required_bucket_count.description: Buckets that are not a server access log destination, the population logging_enabled covers.

account_public_access_block_enabled.description: Whether the account-level S3 Block Public Access settings set all four flags.

buckets.description: Audit level and above: one row per bucket, up to 10,000. Past the cap, the first by name are kept.

RDSMetrics.description: RDS databases across the scanned regions. The figures cover the regions whose listing succeeded, and are meaningful only when regions_failed is absent.

regions_evaluated_count.description: Regions whose RDS listing succeeded. The aggregates cover only these regions and are meaningful only when regions_failed is absent.

event_subscription_count.description: RDS event subscriptions across the evaluated regions.

backup_failure_alerting_subscription_cou.description: Enabled subscriptions that would carry a backup failure. Empty event categories cover everything, so subscribe-to-all subscriptions count.

backup_failure_alerting_reaching_subscri.description: Subscriptions where the chain completes: covering backup failures and delivering to a topic with a confirmed subscriber.

backup_alerting_topics_unresolved_count.description: Covering subscriptions whose topic subscribers could not be read, so their reach is unproven.

event_subscriptions_unresolved_region_co.description: Regions where event subscriptions could not be listed.

dml_logging_configured_count.description: Postgres instances whose engine configuration logs data changes and exports the log off the instance: pgaudit with write coverage or log_statement at mod or all, parameter group in sync.

dml_logging_not_exported_count.description: Instances logging data changes into a log that never leaves the instance.

dml_logging_pending_count.description: Instances whose logging configuration awaits a reboot: desired, not in force.

dml_logging_not_configured_count.description: Postgres instances whose engine configuration does not log data changes.

dml_logging_unknown_count.description: Instances whose parameters could not be read. Unknown is never reported as not configured.

dml_logging_not_classified_count.description: Engines this classifier does not interpret, including aurora-postgresql, whose settings live in cluster parameter groups.

regions_failed.description: Regions whose RDS listing failed. Absent when every region evaluated.

database_count.description: Instances plus clusters across evaluated regions, so vacuous aggregates (zero databases) are distinguishable from real ones.

instance_count.description: DB instances across the evaluated regions; database_count adds the clusters.

encrypted_at_rest.description: Percentage of databases with storage encrypted at rest. Null when there are none.

encrypted_at_rest_database_count.description: Databases with storage encrypted at rest.

publicly_accessible.description: Percentage of DB instances that are publicly accessible. Null when there are none.

publicly_accessible_instance_count.description: DB instances that are publicly accessible.

deletion_protection.description: Percentage of databases with deletion protection on. Null when there are none.

backup_retention_adequate.description: Percentage of databases keeping automated backups for at least 7 days. Null when there are none.

backup_retention_adequate_database_count.description: Databases keeping automated backups for at least 7 days.

backup_retention_min.description: The shortest automated backup retention across the databases, in days. Null when there are no databases.

multi_az_enabled.description: Percentage of databases with a standby or replicas in another availability zone. Null when there are none.

multi_az_enabled_database_count.description: Databases with a standby or replicas in another availability zone.

db_port_open_to_internet_count.description: Instances whose security groups allow ingress from the internet on the database's listening port. Unevaluated instances are excluded; reachability there is unproven, not open.

db_port_ingress_unevaluated_count.description: Instances whose database-port ingress could not be evaluated: no endpoint port yet, or the security groups could not be read.

instances.description: Audit level and above: one row per DB instance.

clusters.description: Audit level and above: one row per DB cluster.

NetworkMetrics.description: VPCs and security groups across the scanned regions. The figures cover the regions whose listing succeeded, and are meaningful only when regions_failed is absent: partial coverage can only understate exposure.

regions_evaluated_count.description: Regions whose network listing succeeded. The exposure aggregates cover only these regions and are meaningful only when regions_failed is absent: partial coverage can only understate exposure.

regions_failed.description: Regions whose network listing failed. Absent when every region evaluated.

security_group_count.description: Security groups across the evaluated regions.

open_to_world_ssh.description: Percentage of security groups allowing SSH (TCP 22) from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, including all-traffic rules. Null when there are no security groups.

open_to_world_ssh_security_group_count.description: Security groups allowing SSH (TCP 22) from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, including all-traffic rules.

open_to_world_rdp.description: Percentage of security groups allowing RDP (TCP 3389) from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, including all-traffic rules. Null when there are no security groups.

open_to_world_rdp_security_group_count.description: Security groups allowing RDP (TCP 3389) from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, including all-traffic rules.

vpcs.description: Audit level and above: one row per VPC.

security_groups.description: Audit level and above: one row per security group.

cloudtrail.description: CloudTrail trails, their logging status, and their delivery buckets.

trail_buckets_retained_indefinitely_coun.description: Trail delivery buckets with no covering lifecycle expiration: audit logs are kept until someone deletes them. Meets a retain-for-N requirement and fails a delete-after-N one.

trail_buckets_expiring_count.description: Trail delivery buckets whose lifecycle rules expire the trail's objects after a number of days.

trail_bucket_min_expiration_days.description: The shortest covering expiration across trail buckets: the binding retention number. Transitions to colder storage preserve data and are not counted as expiration.

trail_buckets_not_in_account_count.description: Delivery buckets outside this account, the normal shape for organization trails delivering to a log archive account. Enroll that account to make them readable.

trail_buckets_retention_unknown_count.description: Delivery buckets whose lifecycle could not be read, or that expire the trail's objects only on a set date rather than after a number of days.

trail_buckets_object_locked_count.description: Delivery buckets with object lock default retention: nobody shortens audit log retention, not even an administrator when the mode is COMPLIANCE.

trail_buckets_public_access_blocked_coun.description: Delivery buckets with an effective public access block: each of its flags set at the account level or the bucket level.

trail_buckets_public_access_not_blocked_.description: Delivery buckets with no effective public access block. A trail bucket has no legitimate public readership, so this is an unambiguous finding. The block is the shield: bucket policy and ACL exposure are examined separately at internal level.

trail_buckets_public_access_unknown_coun.description: Delivery buckets whose block state could not be fully read. Not-blocked needs both the account and bucket sides known, because the unreadable side could set the flags the other lacks.

trail_listing_evaluated.description: True when the trail listing was collected. The summary booleans are meaningful only when true; on listing failure they are null.

trail_listing_error_code.description: Present when the trail listing was not evaluated.

multi_region_enabled.description: Whether a multi-region trail is logging.

organization_trail_enabled.description: Whether an organization trail is logging.

trail_status_evaluated_count.description: Trails whose logging status was read.

trail_status_inferred_count.description: Trail statuses inferred from organization shadow-trail presence when the member account could not read GetTrailStatus.

trail_status_unknown_count.description: Trails whose logging status could not be read or inferred.

trails.description: Audit level and above: one row per trail, an organization trail once.

config.description: AWS Config in the primary region, the first region scanned.

recorder_running.description: Whether a configuration recorder is recording.

recorders.description: Audit level and above: one row per configuration recorder.

rules.description: Internal level only: one row per rule with its compliance, up to 1,000. Past the cap, the first by name are kept.

rules_truncated.description: Whether the rule list was cut at 1,000 rules.

rules_dropped_count.description: Rules left out past the cap.

enabled.description: Whether a GuardDuty detector exists in any scanned region.

unremediated_findings_over_48h.description: Unarchived findings of severity 7 or higher, high or critical, last updated more than 48 hours ago, across the detectors.

finding_notification.description: Whether findings are routed anywhere a person would see them. GuardDuty publishes findings to the regional default EventBridge bus; these fields summarise the rules pointed at it, region by region. Routed means an enabled matching rule with at least one target; reaching a subscriber additionally requires an SNS target with a confirmed subscription. Rules notifying through Lambda or an API destination count as routed but never as reaching, since delivery beyond the invocation is not observable from configuration. In organizations, member accounts commonly route findings centrally: administrator_account_id present explains detector regions with no local rules.

rule_count.description: Enabled or disabled rules matching GuardDuty findings, across evaluated detector regions.

detector_regions_evaluated_count.description: Detector regions where the rule listing succeeded. evaluated + unresolved = detector_regions_count.

detector_regions_unresolved_count.description: Detector regions where the rule listing failed. Excluded from routed/reaching rather than counted as unrouted.

detector_regions_routed_count.description: Detector regions with an enabled rule that matches GuardDuty findings and has a target.

detector_regions_reaching_subscriber_cou.description: Detector regions where such a rule targets an SNS topic with a confirmed subscription.

subscriptions_by_protocol.description: Counts only. Subscription endpoints are never collected: they are email addresses, phone numbers, and webhook URLs.

subscriptions_pending_confirmation_count.description: Subscriptions on the targeted topics still waiting for confirmation. They deliver nothing.

topics_unresolved_count.description: Targeted topics whose subscriptions could not be read.

administrator_account_id.description: The GuardDuty administrator account when this account is an organization member.

rules.description: Audit level and above: one row per EventBridge rule matching GuardDuty findings.

detectors.description: Audit level and above: one row per detector, one per region at most.

findings.description: Internal level only: unarchived findings of severity 7 or higher, up to 5,000 per detector.

findings_truncated.description: Whether any detector's findings were cut at 5,000.

findings_dropped_count.description: Findings left out past the cap.

access_analyzer.description: IAM Access Analyzer coverage, region by region. Only an ACTIVE analyzer analyzes anything, and in an organization the analyzer often lives in a delegated administrator account, so absence here is not absence of coverage.

enabled.description: Whether an ACTIVE analyzer exists in any scanned region.

analyzer_count.description: Analyzers across the evaluated regions, in any status.

regions_unresolved_count.description: Regions whose analyzers could not be listed.

inactive_analyzer_count.description: Analyzers that are creating, disabled, or failed: configuration present, coverage absent.

organization_analyzer_present.description: Whether an analyzer of type ORGANIZATION exists.

active_findings_count.description: Active findings across the ACTIVE analyzers.

archived_findings_count.description: Archived findings mean someone triages them; a pile of stale active findings means nobody looks.

analyzers_with_unresolved_findings_count.description: Active analyzers whose findings could not be listed. Excluded from the finding counts rather than counted as zero.

analyzers.description: Audit level and above: one row per analyzer.

security_hub.description: Security Hub in the primary region, the first region scanned, and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark controls it scores.

auto_enable_controls.description: Whether Security Hub turns on new controls in the subscribed standards automatically. Absent when it does not.

integration_count.description: Product integrations sending findings to Security Hub.

standards_arns.description: Audit level and above: the ARNs of the standards subscribed to.

product_subscriptions.description: Audit level and above: the ARNs of the product subscriptions that send findings.

cis_aws_foundations_benchmark_level_1.description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark level 1 controls, across the subscribed CIS standards.

cis_aws_foundations_benchmark_level_2.description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark level 2 controls, across the subscribed CIS standards.

cis_aws_foundations_benchmark_unknown_le.description: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark controls whose findings name no profile level.

inspector.description: Amazon Inspector, read from its findings in Security Hub in the primary region. EC2 instances are the resources counted.

status_evaluated.description: True when the Inspector status was read (including a genuine absence). enabled and unpatched_server_percent are meaningful only when true.

status_error_code.description: Present when the Inspector status was not evaluated.

enabled.description: Whether Security Hub holds any Inspector finding.

unpatched_server_percent.description: Percentage of EC2 instances with Inspector findings that have an unpatched finding. Null when no instance has a finding.

total_affected_resources.description: EC2 instances with at least one Inspector finding.

unpatched_resources.description: EC2 instances with at least one unpatched finding.

patched_findings.description: Findings archived, or with a workflow status of RESOLVED or SUPPRESSED.

unpatched_findings.description: Findings neither archived nor resolved nor suppressed.

CISComplianceByLevel.description: The CIS controls at one profile level, by their findings' compliance status.

enabled.description: Whether any control at this level has a finding.

scored_controls.description: Controls passed, failed, or warning, the population compliance_percent covers.

compliance_percent.description: Percentage of scored controls that passed. Null when none were scored.

compliance_state.description: FAILED when any control failed, else WARNING when any warned, else PASSED when any passed, else NOT_AVAILABLE when every control was unavailable, else UNKNOWN.

warning_controls.description: Controls with a warning finding and no failed one.

not_available_controls.description: Controls Security Hub could not check, such as for an unsupported resource.

IdentityCenterStatus.description: AWS IAM Identity Center (formerly AWS SSO) posture.

enabled.description: Whether an IdC instance exists in the primary region.

instance_region.description: The region the instance was found in.

identity_store_id.description: The ID of the instance's identity store.

permission_sets.description: Audit level and above: one row per permission set.

users.description: Audit level and above: one row per identity store user. No personal data beyond the primary email is collected.

groups.description: Audit level and above: one row per identity store group, with its direct members.

account_assignments.description: Audit level and above: who holds which permission set in which account, up to 10,000. Past the cap, the first by account, permission set, and principal are kept. Meaningful only when assignments_evaluated is true.

assignments_evaluated.description: True when the assignment listing was fully collected. On failure the array is empty and this is false; a partial inventory is never emitted.

assignments_truncated.description: Whether the assignments were cut at 10,000.

assignments_dropped_count.description: Assignments left out past the cap.

LambdaMetrics.description: Lambda functions across the scanned regions.

function_count.description: Lambda functions across the scanned regions.

public_function_url_count.description: Audit enrichment: functions with a publicly-invokable Function URL (auth_type=NONE).

functions.description: Audit level and above: one row per function, up to 5,000. Past the cap, the most recently modified are kept.

functions_truncated.description: Whether the function list was cut at 5,000.

functions_dropped_count.description: Functions left out past the cap.

EC2Metrics.description: EC2 instances and EBS volumes across the scanned regions.

imdsv2_required_count.description: Running instances that require IMDSv2 session tokens.

public_ip_count.description: Running instances with a public IP address.

default_vpc_count.description: Running instances in a default VPC.

unattached_volume_count.description: EBS volumes attached to no instance. They retain their data and are not covered by the instance figure below.

unattached_unencrypted_volume_count.description: Unattached volumes without encryption at rest.

instances_with_unencrypted_volume_count.description: Running instances with at least one unencrypted EBS volume attached.

instances.description: Audit level and above: one row per instance in any state, up to 10,000. Past the cap, the most recently launched are kept.

instances_truncated.description: Whether the instance list was cut at 10,000.

instances_dropped_count.description: Instances left out past the cap.

AutoScalingMetrics.description: EC2 auto scaling groups: the instance-based sibling of the ECS capacity evidence.

group_count.description: Auto Scaling groups across the scanned regions.

single_instance_group_count.description: Groups whose minimum size is one instance or none: no redundancy at the floor. Sometimes deliberate, as in the bastion pattern where the group exists for self-healing rather than capacity.

groups_with_scaling_policy_count.description: Groups with at least one scaling policy. A group without one holds capacity but only changes it when told to.

groups_with_suspended_processes_count.description: Groups with scaling processes suspended: the configuration is present but inert.

groups_with_elb_health_check_count.description: Groups replacing instances on load balancer health, so an instance is replaced when the application stops answering rather than only when the VM dies.

load_balanced_groups_without_elb_health_.description: Load-balanced groups still on EC2-only health checks. The target group stops routing to a hung application, but the instance is never replaced because the VM reports healthy: detection without response.

groups_on_launch_configurations_count.description: Groups still on launch configurations, which AWS has deprecated in favor of launch templates.

groups.description: Audit level and above: one row per group.

min_size.description: The fewest instances the group can scale to.

max_size.description: The most instances the group can scale to.

desired_capacity.description: The instances the group is set to run now.

availability_zone_count.description: Availability zones the group launches into.

health_check_type.description: What replaces an instance: EC2 for the instance's own status, or ELB for the load balancer's health check as well.

health_check_grace_period_seconds.description: How long a new instance is exempt from health replacement while it boots. Too short causes replacement loops; too long delays detection.

uses_launch_template.description: Whether the group launches from a launch template rather than a launch configuration.

load_balanced.description: Whether the group registers its instances with a load balancer or target group.

suspended_process_count.description: Scaling processes suspended on the group.

ECSMetrics.description: Container service capacity: how services scale and how deployments fail safe. Task definitions are never read, because container definitions embed environment variables that routinely hold credentials.

cluster_count.description: Clusters running at least one service, across the scanned regions.

fargate_service_count.description: Services on the Fargate launch type.

services_with_autoscaling_count.description: Services with a registered capacity range.

services_with_scaling_policy_count.description: Services where the chain is complete: capacity bounds registered and a policy that moves the service between them.

single_task_service_count.description: Services whose capacity floor is one task: the scaling minimum where registered, otherwise the desired count. One task is zero redundancy.

services_with_circuit_breaker_count.description: Services whose deployments stop automatically when new tasks fail to become healthy.

services_with_public_ip_count.description: Services whose tasks receive public IP addresses. Zero corroborates a private-subnet architecture.

load_balanced_service_count.description: Services registered with a load balancer.

exec_enabled_service_count.description: Services with ECS Exec enabled, which allows an interactive shell into running containers.

scaling_unresolved_service_count.description: Services whose scaling state could not be read. Excluded from the capacity findings rather than counted as unscaled.

services.description: Audit level and above: one row per service.

ECSServiceRow.description: An ECS service. Task definitions are never read.

cluster.description: The cluster the service runs in.

launch_type.description: FARGATE, EC2, or EXTERNAL. Absent when the service uses a capacity provider strategy.

desired_count.description: Tasks the service is set to run.

auto_scaled.description: Whether Application Auto Scaling registers a capacity range for the service.

min_capacity.description: The fewest tasks auto scaling can scale to. Absent when not auto scaled.

max_capacity.description: The most tasks auto scaling can scale to. Absent when not auto scaled.

scaling_policy_types.description: The types of the scaling policies, such as TargetTrackingScaling.

scaling_metrics.description: The metrics the scaling policies track, predefined or custom.

circuit_breaker_enabled.description: Whether a deployment stops when new tasks fail to become healthy.

circuit_breaker_rollback.description: Whether a stopped deployment rolls back to the last working one.

minimum_healthy_percent.description: The share of desired tasks that must stay healthy during a deployment, in percent.

maximum_percent.description: The most tasks a deployment may run, as a percentage of desired tasks.

assigns_public_ip.description: Whether the service's tasks receive public IP addresses.

subnet_count.description: Subnets the service's tasks run in. 0 for a service without awsvpc networking, which names none of its own.

load_balanced.description: Whether the service is registered with a load balancer.

execute_command_enabled.description: Whether ECS Exec is on, allowing an interactive shell into running containers.

health_check_grace_period_seconds.description: How long new tasks are exempt from load balancer health replacement while they start.

scaling_unresolved.description: Whether the service's scaling could not be read. Absent when it was.

TargetGroupRow.description: A load balancer target group: how the load balancer decides a backend is dead.

protocol.description: The protocol to the targets, such as HTTP or TCP.

target_type.description: What the targets are: instance, ip, lambda, or alb.

healthy_threshold_count.description: Passing checks in a row before a target counts as healthy.

unhealthy_threshold_count.description: Failing checks in a row before a target counts as unhealthy.

attached.description: Whether any load balancer uses this target group.

SESMetrics.description: Outbound mail transport enforcement. SES attempts TLS on every delivery and falls back to plaintext unless a configuration set says REQUIRE, so only REQUIRE counts as enforced.

configuration_set_count.description: Configuration sets across the scanned regions.

configuration_sets_requiring_tls_count.description: Configuration sets whose TLS policy is REQUIRE, so mail sent through them is never delivered in plaintext.

configuration_sets_opportunistic_tls_cou.description: Sets whose policy is OPTIONAL or unset. Both mean TLS is attempted and plaintext is the fallback.

configuration_sets_unresolved_count.description: Sets whose details could not be read, so their policy is unproven rather than opportunistic.

identity_count.description: Sending identities, email addresses and domains, across the scanned regions.

identities_requiring_tls_count.description: Sending-enabled identities whose default configuration set requires TLS, so mail naming no set at send time is covered. A send that names its own set can override this; that choice is per message and not visible in config.

sending_disabled_identity_count.description: Identities whose sending is turned off.

identities_unresolved_count.description: Sending-enabled identities whose details could not be read, so whether they require TLS is unproven.

configuration_sets.description: Audit level and above: one row per configuration set.

identities.description: Audit level and above: one row per sending identity.

tls_policy.description: REQUIRE or OPTIONAL. Absent when the set declares none, which SES treats as OPTIONAL.

unresolved.description: Whether the set's details could not be read. Absent when they were.

default_configuration_set.description: The configuration set applied to mail that names none.

default_requires_tls.description: Whether that default set's TLS policy is REQUIRE.

unresolved.description: Whether the identity's details could not be read. Absent when they were.

CloudFrontMetrics.description: CloudFront distribution transport enforcement on both hops: viewer to edge, and edge to origin. Meaningful only when distributions_evaluated is true, so an unread account is never mistaken for one with no distributions.

distributions_evaluated.description: Whether the distributions were listed. The other values are meaningful only when true.

distributions_error_code.description: Why the distributions could not be listed.

disabled_distribution_count.description: Distributions that are switched off. Their configuration is latent, so they are excluded from the findings below.

distributions_allowing_plaintext_viewers.description: Enabled distributions where any cache behavior, default or path-scoped, is set to allow-all. Redirect-to-HTTPS and HTTPS-only both deliver content over TLS.

distributions_with_http_only_origin_coun.description: Enabled distributions fetching from at least one custom origin over plaintext regardless of the viewer policy.

distributions_with_match_viewer_origin_c.description: Enabled distributions whose origin fetch mirrors the viewer's scheme, so the origin hop is plaintext whenever the viewer request was.

distributions_by_minimum_tls.description: Enabled distributions by minimum viewer TLS version.

distributions.description: Audit level and above: one row per distribution.

CloudFrontDistributionRow.description: A CloudFront distribution and the protocols on both hops.

aliases.description: The alternate domain names it serves.

allows_plaintext_viewers.description: Whether any cache behavior, default or path-scoped, lets viewers use HTTP without a redirect to HTTPS.

minimum_protocol_version.description: The oldest TLS version viewers can use, such as TLSv1.2_2021.

http_only_origin_count.description: Custom origins CloudFront fetches from over HTTP only.

match_viewer_origin_count.description: Custom origins fetched over the viewer's protocol, so plaintext whenever the viewer used HTTP.

https_only_origin_count.description: Custom origins fetched over HTTPS only.

s3_origin_count.description: S3 REST origins, which declare no protocol in config and so are counted rather than classified.

LoadBalancerMetrics.description: Load balancer transport enforcement: which hops force TLS toward the client and which accept plaintext.

load_balancer_count.description: Load balancers across the scanned regions.

albs_serving_plaintext_count.description: ALBs with at least one HTTP listener whose default action is not a redirect to HTTPS. Listener rules beyond the default action are not inspected.

internet_facing_albs_serving_plaintext_c.description: The subset of plaintext-serving ALBs reachable from the internet.

albs_without_https_listener_count.description: ALBs with readable listeners and no HTTPS listener at all.

nlb_tls_listener_count.description: NLB listeners terminating TLS at the load balancer.

nlb_tcp_passthrough_listener_count.description: NLB listeners forwarding bytes untouched. Whether the stream is encrypted is decided by the endpoints, not this hop.

single_zone_load_balancer_count.description: Load balancers spanning one availability zone: no zone redundancy. ALBs cannot be single-zone by AWS rule, so this in practice counts network load balancers.

target_group_count.description: Target groups across the scanned regions.

target_groups_without_health_check_count.description: Target groups with health checking off, so the load balancer cannot detect a dead backend.

target_group_listing_failed_region_count.description: Regions where target groups could not be listed, so their health-check posture is unproven.

tls_listeners_by_policy.description: TLS-terminating listeners by security policy name. The policy fixes the minimum TLS version the listener accepts.

listeners_unresolved_count.description: Load balancers whose listeners could not be read, so their transport posture is unproven rather than clean.

load_balancers.description: Audit level and above: one row per load balancer.

target_groups.description: Audit level and above: one row per target group.

LoadBalancerRow.description: An Elastic Load Balancing load balancer.

availability_zone_count.description: Availability zones the load balancer serves.

listeners.description: The load balancer's listeners. Absent when it has none.

listeners_unresolved.description: Whether the listeners could not be read. Absent when they were.

port.description: The port the listener accepts connections on.

protocol.description: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, TLS, UDP, or TCP_UDP.

ssl_policy.description: The security policy of a TLS-terminating listener, which fixes the oldest TLS version it accepts.

redirects_to_https.description: Whether the listener's default action redirects to HTTPS.

StoredImageMetrics.description: Owned EBS snapshots and AMIs: public exposure and encryption at rest. Volumes attached to running instances are covered under ec2 instead.

snapshot_count.description: Snapshots owned by this account. Snapshots owned by others are never listed.

unencrypted_snapshot_count.description: Owned snapshots without encryption at rest.

public_snapshot_count.description: Owned snapshots that anyone can restore.

snapshot_exposure_unknown.description: The public-exposure check failed in at least one region, so a zero public count is unproven rather than clean.

images_with_unencrypted_volume_count.description: Images with at least one unencrypted EBS device. Instance-store images have no EBS device and are counted in neither direction.

public_image_count.description: Owned AMIs that anyone can launch.

image_exposure_unknown.description: The AMI lookup failed in at least one region, so a zero public count is unproven.

public_snapshots.description: Audit level and above: one row per owned snapshot anyone can restore.

public_images.description: Audit level and above: one row per owned AMI anyone can launch.

PublicResourceRow.description: A snapshot or AMI anyone can read.

name.description: The AMI's name. Absent for a snapshot.

encrypted.description: Whether it is encrypted at rest. For an AMI, whether every EBS volume it holds is encrypted.

created_at.description: When the AMI was created. Absent for a snapshot.

MonitoringMetrics.description: CloudWatch alarms and how far their notifications travel. Zero alarms is not evidence that nobody is paged: escalation through EventBridge or a third-party monitor is not visible here.

alarm_count.description: Metric alarms across the scanned regions.

alarms_with_actions_disabled_count.description: Alarms that evaluate but take no action.

alarms_without_notification_count.description: Alarms with no notification topic attached.

alarms_insufficient_data_count.description: Alarms that have never had enough data to evaluate.

alarms_reaching_subscriber_count.description: Alarms whose escalation chain is unbroken: actions enabled, a notification topic attached, and that topic holding at least one confirmed subscriber.

notification_topic_count.description: Distinct SNS topics the alarms notify whose subscriptions were read.

topics_unresolved_count.description: Topics whose subscriptions could not be read.

subscriptions_by_protocol.description: Subscriber counts per protocol. Endpoints are never collected: they are personal contact details, and an HTTPS endpoint is routinely a webhook URL that is itself a credential.

subscriptions_pending_confirmation_count.description: Subscriptions that never deliver until confirmed.

alarms.description: Audit level and above: one row per alarm.

alarms_truncated.description: Not emitted: the alarm list is not capped.

alarms_dropped_count.description: Not emitted: the alarm list is not capped.

namespace.description: The metric's namespace, such as AWS/EC2.

comparison_operator.description: How the metric is compared with the threshold, such as GreaterThanThreshold.

threshold.description: The value the metric is compared with. Absent for an alarm on an anomaly detection band.

actions_enabled.description: Whether the alarm's actions run when its state changes.

notification_topics.description: Count of SNS topics this alarm notifies.

reaches_subscriber.description: Whether actions are enabled and a notified topic has a confirmed subscription.

other_action_count.description: Alarm actions that are not SNS topics, counted but not named.

CloudWatchLogsMetrics.description: CloudWatch log groups across the scanned regions. No log content is ever collected.

log_group_count.description: Total log groups across scanned regions.

log_groups_without_retention_count.description: Log groups with no retention setting, which in CloudWatch Logs means they retain indefinitely. Read as a data-minimisation finding, not a retention gap: a group counted here keeps everything forever, so it satisfies a retain-for-N-months requirement while failing a delete-after-N-months one.

log_groups_without_customer_kms_count.description: Log groups encrypted with an AWS-managed key rather than a customer-managed KMS key.

log_groups.description: Audit level and above: one row per log group, up to 10,000. Past the cap, the largest are kept.

log_groups_truncated.description: Whether the log group list was cut at 10,000.

log_groups_dropped_count.description: Log groups left out past the cap.

KMSMetrics.description: KMS posture scoped to CUSTOMER-managed keys only.

customer_managed_key_count.description: Customer managed keys across the scanned regions.

cmks_with_rotation_disabled_count.description: Keys KMS can rotate automatically that have automatic rotation off. KMS rotates only symmetric keys whose key material it generated, so asymmetric and HMAC keys, imported key material, and keys in a custom key store are not counted.

cmks_pending_deletion_count.description: Customer managed keys scheduled for deletion.

keys.description: Audit level and above: one row per customer managed key, up to 5,000. Past the cap, the most recently created are kept.

keys_truncated.description: Whether the key list was cut at 5,000.

keys_dropped_count.description: Keys left out past the cap.

SecretsManagerMetrics.description: Secrets Manager metadata only. Secret VALUES are never collected.

secrets_without_customer_kms_count.description: Secrets encrypted with the AWS managed key rather than a customer managed one.

secrets.description: Audit level and above: one row per secret, up to 5,000. Past the cap, the most recently changed are kept.

secrets_truncated.description: Whether the secret list was cut at 5,000.

secrets_dropped_count.description: Secrets left out past the cap.

SSMParametersMetrics.description: SSM Parameter Store metadata only. Parameter VALUES are never collected.

secure_string_count.description: SecureString parameters, the ones stored encrypted.

secure_strings_without_customer_kms_coun.description: SecureString parameters encrypted with the AWS managed key rather than a customer managed one.

parameters.description: Audit level and above: one row per parameter, up to 10,000. Past the cap, the most recently changed are kept.

parameters_truncated.description: Whether the parameter list was cut at 10,000.

parameters_dropped_count.description: Parameters left out past the cap.

WAFMetrics.description: WAFv2 web ACL coverage of the account's internet-facing entry points. regions_evaluated_count and cloudfront_scope_evaluated record which scopes answered, so an unread scope is not mistaken for an unprotected one.

web_acl_count.description: Web ACLs across the scanned regions and the CloudFront scope.

regions_evaluated_count.description: Regions whose web ACLs were listed.

cloudfront_scope_evaluated.description: Whether the CloudFront-scope web ACLs and the distributions were listed.

internet_facing_alb_count.description: Internet-facing application load balancers across the scanned regions.

covered_internet_facing_alb_count.description: Internet-facing application load balancers associated with a web ACL.

internet_facing_alb_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of internet-facing application load balancers associated with a web ACL. Null when there are none.

covered_distribution_count.description: Enabled CloudFront distributions with a web ACL attached.

distribution_coverage_pct.description: Percentage of enabled CloudFront distributions with a web ACL attached. Null when there are none.

rate_limiting_enforced.description: True when at least one web ACL protecting a resource carries an active rate-based rule whose action is block.

web_acls.description: Audit level and above: one row per web ACL, the most attached first, up to 1,000.

web_acls_truncated.description: Whether the web ACL list was cut at 1,000.

web_acls_dropped_count.description: Web ACLs left out past the cap.

IAMUserRow.description: An IAM user, from the credential report.

mfa_active.description: Whether the user has an MFA device active.

has_console_access.description: Whether the user has a console password.

has_access_keys.description: Whether the user has at least one active access key.

IAMRoleRow.description: An IAM role and what its trust policy allows from outside the account.

has_external_trust.description: Whether the trust policy allows a principal outside this account: another account, or anyone through a wildcard principal. Service principals are never external.

has_wildcard_principal.description: Whether the trust policy allows any principal through the wildcard "*".

external_trust_account_ids.description: The other accounts the trust policy names as principals, sorted. Absent when it names none.

external_trust_in_org.description: Whether every account in external_trust_account_ids belongs to this account's organization. An account outside any organization has none in it. Absent when the trust policy names no other account.

IAMCredentialReportUserRow.description: One user's row in the IAM credential report. A timestamp is absent when the event never happened.

user_name.description: The user's name. The root user is "<root_account>", as AWS names it.

user_creation_time.description: When the user was created, in RFC 3339.

password_enabled.description: Whether the user has a console password.

password_last_used.description: When the password was last used to sign in, in RFC 3339. Absent when never.

password_last_changed.description: When the password was last changed, in RFC 3339. Absent when never.

password_next_rotation.description: When the password policy next requires a new password, in RFC 3339. Absent when passwords do not expire.

mfa_active.description: Whether an MFA device is active.

access_key_1_active.description: Whether the first access key is active.

access_key_1_last_rotated.description: When the first access key was created or last rotated, in RFC 3339. Absent when the user has no first key.

access_key_1_last_used_date.description: When the first access key was last used, in RFC 3339. Absent when never.

access_key_1_last_used_region.description: The region the first access key was last used in. Absent when never.

access_key_1_last_used_service.description: The AWS service the first access key was last used with. Absent when never.

access_key_2_active.description: Whether the second access key is active.

access_key_2_last_rotated.description: When the second access key was created or last rotated, in RFC 3339. Absent when the user has no second key.

access_key_2_last_used_date.description: When the second access key was last used, in RFC 3339. Absent when never.

access_key_2_last_used_region.description: The region the second access key was last used in. Absent when never.

access_key_2_last_used_service.description: The AWS service the second access key was last used with. Absent when never.

tls_enforcement.description: How the bucket policy treats plaintext requests: enforced when a deny on aws:SecureTransport covers every principal, action, and object, partial when a transport deny covers less, and none when the policy says nothing about transport or there is no policy.

public_access_blocked.description: Whether the bucket's effective S3 Block Public Access settings block public access: each of the four flags set by the account or by the bucket.

default_encryption_enabled.description: Whether default encryption is enabled. S3 applies SSE-S3 to every bucket, so a bucket with no rule of its own counts as encrypted.

default_encryption_evaluated.description: Whether default encryption was read, or inferred from S3's SSE-S3 baseline.

default_encryption_error_code.description: Why default encryption could not be read, or ServerSideEncryptionConfigurationNotFoundError when the bucket has no rule of its own and S3's baseline applies.

logging_enabled.description: Whether server access logging is enabled.

is_log_sink.description: Whether another bucket delivers its server access logs here. Absent when none does.

policy.description: The bucket policy. Absent when the bucket has none.

document.description: The policy document, as S3 returns it.

owner_id.description: The canonical user ID of the bucket's owner.

has_public_grant.description: Whether any grant is to the AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers group.

lifecycle.description: The bucket's lifecycle configuration. Absent when the bucket has none.

S3BucketACLGrantRow.description: One grant in a bucket ACL. Either grantee_uri or grantee_id is set.

grantee_type.description: The kind of grantee: CanonicalUser, AmazonCustomerByEmail, or Group.

grantee_uri.description: The group a Group grant names, such as http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers.

grantee_id.description: The canonical user ID a CanonicalUser grant names.

permission.description: The permission granted: FULL_CONTROL, WRITE, WRITE_ACP, READ, or READ_ACP.

S3LifecycleRuleRow.description: One rule in a bucket's lifecycle configuration.

prefix.description: The object key prefix the rule covers. Absent when it covers the whole bucket.

transitions.description: Each transition to another storage class, as the class and the days or date it happens after.

expiration.description: When the rule expires objects, as days after creation or a date. Absent when the rule expires nothing.

engine.description: The database engine, such as postgres or mysql.

storage_encrypted.description: Whether storage is encrypted at rest.

publicly_accessible.description: Whether the instance has a publicly resolvable address. Its security groups still decide what can reach it.

backup_retention_period.description: Days automated backups are kept. 0 means automated backups are off.

preferred_backup_window.description: The daily window automated backups run in, in UTC.

multi_az.description: Whether the instance has a standby in another availability zone.

dml_logging.description: How the instance logs data changes: configured, configured_not_exported, pending_reboot, not_configured, unknown, or not_classified, as the dml_logging counts describe.

db_port_ingress_evaluated.description: Whether the security groups on the instance's port were read, so the next two fields are known.

db_port_open_to_internet.description: Whether a security group allows ingress from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, on the instance's listening port. Absent when not evaluated.

db_port_ingress_sources.description: The CIDR blocks and source security groups allowed to reach the listening port, sorted. Null when not evaluated, [] when nothing is allowed.

latest_restorable_time.description: The latest time the instance can be restored to, in RFC 3339.

RDSClusterRow.description: An RDS DB cluster. A cluster has no address of its own, so publicly_accessible is on its instances.

engine.description: The database engine, such as aurora-postgresql.

storage_encrypted.description: Whether storage is encrypted at rest.

multi_az.description: Whether the cluster has instances in more than one availability zone.

latest_restorable_time.description: The latest time the cluster can be restored to, in RFC 3339.

is_default.description: Whether it is the region's default VPC.

flow_logs_enabled.description: Whether a flow log captures the VPC's traffic. Absent when not evaluated.

flow_logs_evaluated.description: Whether the VPC's flow logs were read.

flow_logs_error_code.description: Why the flow logs could not be read.

SecurityGroupRow.description: A security group and what it exposes to the internet.

vpc_id.description: The VPC the group belongs to.

is_default.description: Whether it is its VPC's default security group.

open_to_world_ssh.description: Whether a rule allows SSH (TCP 22) from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, including an all-traffic rule.

open_to_world_rdp.description: Whether a rule allows RDP (TCP 3389) from anywhere, 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, including an all-traffic rule.

SecurityGroupIngressRuleRow.description: One ingress rule of a security group.

protocol.description: The IP protocol: tcp, udp, icmp, a protocol number, or -1 for all traffic.

from_port.description: The first port of the range. 0 with protocol -1.

to_port.description: The last port of the range. 0 with protocol -1.

cidr_blocks.description: The IPv4 and IPv6 ranges allowed. 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 is anywhere.

source_sg_ids.description: The security groups whose members are allowed.

home_region.description: The region the trail was created in.

s3_bucket_name.description: The bucket the trail delivers to.

s3_key_prefix.description: The key prefix the trail delivers under. Absent when none.

bucket_retention.description: How long the delivery bucket keeps the trail's objects: indefinite, expiring, not_in_account, or unknown.

bucket_expiration_days.description: Days after which the bucket's lifecycle expires the trail's objects, when bucket_retention is expiring.

bucket_object_lock_mode.description: The delivery bucket's default object lock mode, GOVERNANCE or COMPLIANCE. Absent when it has none.

bucket_public_access.description: Whether the delivery bucket blocks public access: blocked, not_blocked, not_in_account, or unknown.

is_multi_region_trail.description: Whether the trail logs every region.

is_organization_trail.description: Whether the trail logs every account in the organization.

log_file_validation_enabled.description: Whether CloudTrail writes digest files that prove log files were not changed.

kms_encrypted.description: Whether log files are encrypted with a KMS key.

cloudwatch_logs_enabled.description: Whether the trail also delivers to a CloudWatch Logs log group.

trail_status_evaluated.description: Whether the trail's status was read.

trail_status_inferred.description: Whether is_logging was inferred, as for a member account's view of its organization's trail. Absent when not.

trail_status_error_code.description: Why the trail's status could not be read.

kms_key_arn.description: The KMS key the log files are encrypted with.

cloudwatch_logs_arn.description: The CloudWatch Logs log group the trail delivers to.

role_arn.description: The role the recorder uses to read resources.

all_supported.description: Whether it records every supported resource type.

include_global.description: Whether it also records global resources, such as IAM.

ConfigRuleRow.description: An AWS Config rule and its compliance.

source_owner.description: Who supplies the rule: AWS for a managed rule, or CUSTOM_LAMBDA or CUSTOM_POLICY.

source_identifier.description: The managed rule's identifier, or the custom rule's Lambda ARN.

compliance_state.description: COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT, INSUFFICIENT_DATA, or NOT_APPLICABLE, as AWS reports it.

last_evaluated.description: When the rule last evaluated successfully, in RFC 3339.

finding_publishing_freq.description: How often updated findings are published: FIFTEEN_MINUTES, ONE_HOUR, or SIX_HOURS.

s3_logs_enabled.description: Whether S3 data event monitoring is on.

eks_audit_logs_enabled.description: Whether EKS audit log monitoring is on.

malware_scan_enabled.description: Whether malware scanning of EBS volumes is on.

high_or_critical_findings.description: Unarchived findings of severity 7 or higher.

high_or_critical_findings_older_than_48h.description: Those last updated more than 48 hours ago.

GuardDutyFindingRow.description: An unarchived GuardDuty finding of severity 7 or higher.

severity.description: GuardDuty's severity score, from 7 to 10 here.

type.description: The finding type, such as UnauthorizedAccess:EC2/SSHBruteForce.

resource_type.description: The kind of resource involved, such as Instance or AccessKey.

resource_id.description: The resource involved, such as an instance ID or an access key ID.

created_at.description: When the finding was created, in RFC 3339.

updated_at.description: When the finding was last updated, in RFC 3339.

GuardDutyNotificationRuleRow.description: An EventBridge rule that matches GuardDuty findings on its region's default bus.

filters_severity.description: Whether the rule's pattern matches only some severities. Absent when it matches all.

targets_by_kind.description: The rule's targets counted by kind, such as sns or lambda. Absent when it has none.

reaches_subscriber.description: Whether the rule is enabled and targets an SNS topic with a confirmed subscription.

topics.description: The SNS topics the rule targets.

GuardDutyNotificationTopicRow.description: An SNS topic a rule targets, as counts. Subscription endpoints are never collected.

subscriptions_by_protocol.description: Confirmed subscriptions by protocol, such as email or https.

subscriptions_pending_confirmation_count.description: Subscriptions waiting for confirmation, which deliver nothing.

unresolved.description: Whether the topic's subscriptions could not be read. Absent when they were.

type.description: ACCOUNT or ORGANIZATION, or one of the unused access types.

status.description: ACTIVE, CREATING, DISABLED, or FAILED. Only an ACTIVE analyzer analyzes anything.

active_findings_count.description: Active findings. 0 for an analyzer that is not ACTIVE.

archived_findings_count.description: Archived findings. 0 for an analyzer that is not ACTIVE.

findings_unresolved.description: Whether the ACTIVE analyzer's findings could not be listed. Absent when they were.

session_duration_iso8601.description: How long its sessions last, as an ISO 8601 duration such as PT8H.

accounts_assigned_count.description: Accounts the permission set is provisioned to.

provisioned_account_ids.description: The accounts the permission set is provisioned to.

has_inline_policy.description: Whether the permission set has an inline policy. The policy itself is never collected. Absent when it has none.

user_id.description: The user's ID in the identity store.

primary_email.description: The email marked primary on the user. Absent when none is.

group_id.description: The group's ID in the identity store.

member_user_ids.description: The direct user members, as users[].user_id.

IdentityCenterAssignmentRow.description: One principal holding one permission set in one account.

principal_type.description: USER or GROUP. A group's members are in groups[].member_user_ids.

runtime.description: The runtime, such as python3.13. Absent for a container image.

last_modified.description: When the function was last changed, in RFC 3339.

code_size.description: The deployment package's size, in bytes. Absent for a container image.

has_vpc_config.description: Whether the function runs in a VPC. Absent when it does not.

has_resource_policy.description: Whether a resource policy grants others the right to invoke or change the function. Absent when it has none.

has_function_url.description: Whether the function has a function URL. Absent when it has none.

function_url_auth_type.description: How the function URL authenticates callers: AWS_IAM, or NONE for anyone.

deprecated_runtime.description: Whether the runtime is one AWS has deprecated. Absent when it is not.

kms_key_arn.description: The customer managed key encrypting the environment variables.

architectures.description: The instruction set architectures, x86_64 or arm64.

env_var_names.description: The names of the environment variables. Their values are never collected.

instance_type.description: The instance type, such as m7g.large.

state.description: The instance state, such as running or stopped.

launch_time.description: When the instance was launched, in RFC 3339.

image_id.description: The AMI the instance was launched from.

vpc_id.description: The VPC the instance runs in.

subnet_id.description: The subnet the instance runs in.

in_default_vpc.description: Whether the instance runs in a default VPC. Absent when it does not.

has_public_ip.description: Whether the instance has a public IP address. Absent when it does not.

imds_http_tokens.description: The instance metadata service's token setting: required for IMDSv2 only, optional when IMDSv1 is also allowed.

imds_http_hop_limit.description: How many network hops a metadata response may travel.

root_volume_encrypted.description: Whether the root EBS volume is encrypted. Absent when it is not.

iam_instance_profile_arn.description: The instance profile giving the instance its role.

key_name.description: The key pair the instance was launched with.

CloudWatchLogGroupRow.description: A CloudWatch Logs log group. No log content is ever collected.

retention_in_days.description: Days events are kept. 0 means they never expire.

creation_time.description: When the log group was created, in RFC 3339.

has_customer_kms.description: Whether a customer managed KMS key encrypts the log group.

kms_key_arn.description: The customer managed key encrypting the log group.

key_state.description: The key's state, such as Enabled, Disabled, or PendingDeletion.

key_usage.description: What the key is for: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT, SIGN_VERIFY, GENERATE_VERIFY_MAC, or KEY_AGREEMENT.

key_spec.description: The key's type, such as SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT or RSA_2048.

origin.description: Where the key material came from: AWS_KMS, EXTERNAL, AWS_CLOUDHSM, or EXTERNAL_KEY_STORE.

multi_region.description: Whether it is a multi-Region key.

creation_date.description: When the key was created, in RFC 3339.

deletion_date.description: When the key will be deleted, in RFC 3339, while it is pending deletion.

rotation_enabled.description: Whether automatic rotation is on. Always false for a key KMS cannot rotate: an asymmetric or HMAC key, imported key material, or a key in a custom key store.

SecretsManagerSecretRow.description: A Secrets Manager secret's metadata. Its value is never collected.

created_date.description: When the secret was created, in RFC 3339.

last_changed_date.description: When the secret was last changed, in RFC 3339.

last_accessed_date.description: The day the secret was last read, in RFC 3339.

next_rotation_date.description: When the secret next rotates, in RFC 3339.

deletion_date.description: When the secret will be deleted, in RFC 3339, while it is scheduled for deletion.

has_customer_kms.description: Whether a customer managed KMS key encrypts the secret.

primary_region.description: The primary region of a replicated secret.

owning_service.description: The AWS service that manages the secret, such as rds.

kms_key_arn.description: The customer managed key encrypting the secret.

rotation_lambda_arn.description: The Lambda function that rotates the secret.

SSMParameterRow.description: A Parameter Store parameter's metadata. Its value is never collected.

data_type.description: text, or aws:ec2:image for an AMI ID.

last_modified_date.description: When the parameter was last changed, in RFC 3339.

last_modified_user.description: The ARN of who last changed it.

has_customer_kms.description: Whether a customer managed KMS key encrypts the parameter. Always false for String and StringList parameters, which are not encrypted.

scope.description: REGIONAL for regional resources, or CLOUDFRONT.

region.description: The region of a REGIONAL web ACL.

default_action.description: What happens to a request no rule matches: allow or block.

associated_resource_count.description: Resources the web ACL is attached to: application load balancers for REGIONAL, enabled distributions for CLOUDFRONT.

logging_evaluated.description: Whether the logging configuration was read.

logging_enabled.description: Whether the web ACL logs requests.

associated_resource_arns.description: The application load balancers it is attached to.

WAFRuleRow.description: One rule of a web ACL.

priority.description: The rule's priority. Lower runs first.

action.description: What the rule does with a request it matches: block, allow, count, captcha, or challenge. A managed rule group shows managed when it applies its own actions, or count when overridden to count only.

rate_based.description: Whether it is a rate-based rule. Absent when not.

rate_limit.description: Requests allowed per evaluation window before the rule acts, for a rate-based rule.

aggregate_key_type.description: What a rate-based rule counts requests by: IP, FORWARDED_IP, CUSTOM_KEYS, or CONSTANT.

managed_rule_group_name.description: The managed rule group the rule runs, such as AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet.
